My football game had a BIG problem!
It was WAY too easy to just spam every bonus card in your hand. So I had to make a change!
Now, you can still use as many bonus cards as you want on a play… but there's a catch.
If you use ANY bonus cards, you only draw ONE new card after the play.
But if you save them? You draw TWO!
And every first down earns you an extra card!
So now you have to make a decision. Do you go ALL IN on one play, or save your cards for when you really need them?
Did I fix the problem, or just make the game harder?
